# polynomial_algebra_evaluation — polynomials evaluated in a second ring along a coefficient map, the evaluation a ring homomorphism, and the polynomials generated by their constants and variables

A polynomial of `polynomial_algebra` is evaluated in a second ring `R'` at a
coefficient map `φ` and a value `θ(x)` for each variable:
`monomial_eval(R', θ, m)` is the product of the powers `θ(x) ^ m(x)` over
the variables of `m`, and `polynomial_algebra_eval(R, R', φ, θ, f)` the sum
over the support of `φ(f(m))` times the value of `m`. A ring homomorphism
carries a monomial's value to its value at the images, and evaluation keeps
sums and products, so along a ring homomorphism it is a ring homomorphism
out of the polynomials of `S`, sending the constant `a` to `φ(a)` and the
variable `x` to `θ(x)`.

The polynomials are generated by the constants and the variables: the
generator at a monomial is the product of the powers of its variables
(`MonomialAsProduct`), a set holding the constants and closed under sums
and under multiplication by the variables holds every polynomial
(`polynomial_algebra`'s `PolynomialInduction`), and so a ring homomorphism out of the polynomials
of `S` is fixed by its values on the constants and the variables
(`PolynomialAlgebraEvalUnique`).

## Definitions

| member | statement |
|---|---|
| `MonomialEvalDef` | `monomial_eval(R', θ, m)` = the product of `θ(x) ^ m(x)` over the `x` with `m(x) ≠ 0` |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalDef` | `polynomial_algebra_eval(R, R', φ, θ, f)` = the sum over the support of `φ(f(m)) * monomial_eval(R', θ, m)` |

## The value of a monomial

| member | statement |
|---|---|
| `MonomialEvalShift` | `monomial_eval(R, θ, m + eₓ) = θ(x) * monomial_eval(R, θ, m)` for a monomial `m` of `S`, with `θ` in the carrier on `S` and at `x` |
| `MonomialEvalIn` | a monomial of `S` evaluated at values in the carrier on `S` lies in the carrier |
| `MonomialEvalAdd` | a sum of exponents evaluates to the product of the values |
| `MonomialEvalScale` | scaling every value by `c` scales a monomial's value by `c` to its degree |
| `MonomialEvalPow` | raising every value to the `e`-th power raises a monomial's value to the `e`-th power |
| `MonomialEvalNatural` | a ring homomorphism carries a monomial's value to its value at the images of the values |
| `MonomialEvalInIdeal` | a monomial positive at a variable whose value lies in an ideal has its value in the ideal |

## The value of a polynomial

| member | statement |
|---|---|
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalOver` | the value of a coefficient function with values in the carrier is its sum over any finite set of monomials of `S` holding its support |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalIn` | a polynomial of `S` takes its value in `R'` |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalAdd`, `PolynomialAlgebraEvalMul` | evaluation takes sums and products of polynomials of `S` to sums and products of their values |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalHom` | `φ` a ring homomorphism, `θ` valued in `R'` on `S` ⇒ the evaluation is a ring homomorphism from the polynomials of `S` to `R'` |
| `TupleEvaluationHom` | evaluation at a tuple with a carrier value first is a ring homomorphism from the polynomials in the variable 0 |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalMonomial` | the coefficient one at a monomial evaluates to the monomial's value |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalConst`, `PolynomialAlgebraEvalVar` | a constant `a` evaluates to `φ(a)`, the variable `x` to `θ(x)` |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalRestrictTarget` | evaluation into `restrict_ring(T, U)` is evaluation into `T` |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalRestrictCoefficients` | evaluation with the coefficients read in `restrict_ring(R, k)` is evaluation with them read in `R` |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalInSubring` | a polynomial evaluated along a map into a subring, at a point of it, takes its value in that subring |

## Generation and uniqueness

| member | statement |
|---|---|
| `MonomialAsProduct` | the generator at a monomial `m` of `S` is `monomial_eval` of `m` in the polynomials of `S`, at the variables |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalUnique` | two ring homomorphisms out of the polynomials of `S` agreeing on the constants and on the variables of `S` agree |
| `PolynomialAlgebraEvalNatural` | a ring map ψ after evaluation along φ at θ is evaluation along ψ∘φ at ψ∘θ |
| `VariableIdealPrime` | over an integral domain, the ideal a variable generates among the polynomials is prime |
